package_info.why_malicious: There is no evidence or reporting of malicious code in the ldapjs package itself. The package was decommissioned due to maintainer harassment, not due to any discovered malware or compromise.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: There is no indication of malware or compromise in the ldapjs package. No detection is necessary for this package at this time. However, the article highlights the risk of social engineering and harassment as a precursor to potential supply chain attacks, so monitoring for sudden maintainer changes or suspicious new maintainers is recommended.
